message: Without sort, head can return different rows each time the query runs.
howToFix: Add `sort` before `head` when you need stable top or bottom results.

message: Dividing by zero returns no value (null) instead of an error.
howToFix: Use the intended divisor, or handle zero before dividing, for example `if(total = 0, 0, errors / total)`.

message: This window function is not supported in eventstats/streamstats. Only row_number is supported.
howToFix: Use `row_number()` for a window value, or choose an aggregation supported by `eventstats` or `streamstats`, such as `avg()`.

message: The multisearch command requires at least two subsearches.
howToFix: Add a second subsearch, or run the single subsearch as a normal query.

message: This join type is disabled by default.
howToFix: Use an `inner` or `left` join when it preserves the intended result. Otherwise, ask an administrator to enable `plugins.calcite.all_join_types.allowed`.

message: consecutive=true uses an older query engine and may make this query slower.
howToFix: Remove `consecutive=true` to use regular deduplication. No equivalent option preserves consecutive-only behavior.

message: The union command requires at least two datasets.
howToFix: Add another dataset to `union`, or remove `union` when using only one dataset.

message: The replace match and replacement have different numbers of "*" wildcards. The counts must match.
howToFix: Use the same number of `*` wildcards in the match and replacement patterns.
Correct the field name or PPL syntax. PPL runs commands left to right, so define a new field with `eval` before referencing it in a later command.

message: Numeric aggregation on a text field may return no value (null), because text is not stored as a number.
howToFix: Aggregate a numeric field instead. If this field really does hold numbers, map it as a numeric type, or `cast` it before aggregating.

message: PPL cannot search a field stored inside a flat_object field.
howToFix: Use another field or query this data with DQL or the Search API. To use it in PPL, map and reindex it as a regular object field.

message: This field is numeric, but the compared value is not a number, so the comparison returns no rows.
howToFix: Compare the field with a number, such as `500`, or use the text field that contains the value you want.
Use PPL named groups in the form `(?<name>...)`. Start each name with a letter and use only letters and numbers.

message: This operation runs after the index scan, so OpenSearch must read and return its input rows first.
howToFix: Rewrite the highlighted operation with indexed fields and supported functions so the PPL engine can include it in the index request.

message: OpenSearch evaluates this operation as a script for every candidate document instead of using a native index query.
howToFix: Use a direct field comparison or sort on an indexed field so OpenSearch can use a native query or field sort.

message: This field is stored but not searchable, so PPL returns null for it.
howToFix: Query an indexed field instead. To make this value searchable, enable indexing in the mapping and reindex the data.

message: Wildcard source pattern matches no known index.
howToFix: Correct the `source=` pattern or choose an existing index.

message: rex runs the pattern against every input row from the text field, even when it finds no match.
howToFix: Filter out rows that cannot match the pattern before extraction, using time or an indexed field.
